name: GitHub
description: Read and work with repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions runs and code on GitHub through GitHub's hosted MCP server. Sign in with your GitHub account.
examples: List the open pull requests assigned to me and summarize what each one changes.
Find where the retry logic lives in this repository and open an issue for the missing backoff.
Why did the last CI run on main fail? Show the failing job's log.

zh-CN.name: GitHub
zh-CN.description: 通过 GitHub 官方托管的 MCP 服务读取并处理仓库、Issue、Pull Request、Actions 运行与代码。用 GitHub 账号登录。
examples: 列出分配给我的未合并 Pull Request，并概括每个改了什么。
找出这个仓库里重试逻辑在哪，并为缺少退避提一个 Issue。
main 上最近一次 CI 为什么失败？给我看失败任务的日志。
